title: The Maze Runner
author: James Dashner
summary: A teenage boy wakes up in a lift with no memory and arrives in a glade filled with other boys, surrounded by a huge shifting maze. Every day the runners search it for a way out, and every night it is lethal.
readIf: you want a fast, mystery-driven survival story with plenty of cliffhangers.
skipIf: you want fully explained answers, because the questions pile up faster than they are resolved.

pairings.reason: The older, harsher classic about boys building their own rules when adults are not there.
A stronger, more emotional story of young people trapped in a deadly game.
A thoughtful adult mystery about people confined in a sealed world who start to question it.
